en.intro: `scripts/generate_audit_trail.py` (Issue #535) queries the GitHub GraphQL API live and writes two governance-audit Markdown tables: a pull-request audit trail, and a maker/checker log of changes under `policies/`.
en.tableAriaLabel: Audit trail output files and columns
en.freshnessNote: This decision site is a byte-reproducible, `file://`-openable static bundle -- it never embeds live-fetched GitHub data, and cannot. The table below only documents each output file's column structure, not a snapshot of actual content at any point in time. Following the existing `scripts/check-governance-drift` precedent (the script stays available for local/CI verification only, with no additional schedule), this module is not wired into a schedule or an on-merge job that would generate and commit a snapshot either. Run the command below locally or in CI to produce a current audit snapshot yourself.
en.commandOutro: (omit `--repo` to auto-detect the current repository; writes to `docs/audit-trail/` by default, and nothing is committed automatically)

description.zh-tw: 涵蓋每一筆合併進目標分支的 PR：開啟／合併時間、來源→目標分支、連結 Issue 的開啟／關閉時間、Milestone、開發者、審查者，以及依來源分支模式分類的 `governance_stage`（alpha／beta／stable）。
description.en: One row per pull request merged into the target branch: open/merge time, source -> target branch, the linked Issue's open/close time, Milestone, developers, reviewers, and a `governance_stage` classification (alpha/beta/stable) based on the source branch pattern.

description.zh-tw: 只列出改動 `policies/` 路徑的合併 PR：變更時間、`proposed_by`／`proposing_pr`（提案者與 PR），以及 `approved_by`／`approving_review`（核准者與核准的 review）。
description.en: Only merged pull requests that changed a `policies/` path: change time, `proposed_by`/`proposing_pr` (who proposed it and which PR), and `approved_by`/`approving_review` (who approved it and which review).
